summary_1line: Karna tells Krishna he knows the Kauravas are doomed, recounting terrifying omens and prophetic visions foretelling the Pandavas’ victory and massive slaughter.

image_candidates.scene_text: Meteors streak across a dark sky while frightened elephants trumpet and horses shed tears in the Kaurava camp.
In a vision, Yudhishthira in white robes ascends a thousand‑pillared palace while seated on a white throne.
Krishna stands amid a battlefield vision, weapons swirling as the earth below is soaked in blood.
